|game_text='''0 side — Contract Killers'''

''Deploy Coruscant system, Sub City Lair and On The Hunt.'' '''For''' remainder of game, Aurra, Galen, Mara, and your aliens with "plotting to kill Jabba" in lore are assassins. Your cards with ability are deploy +3 except assassins and [Independent] starships. Characters add 1 to their Death Mark total for each weapon or device they carry. Once per turn, may ▼ a Coruscant battleground. '''Flip''' this card if assassins control two battlegrounds (unless opponent's non-droid character at a battleground site) or a [Virtual Block 8] Death Mark attempt is made.

'''7 side — Feared Throughout The Galaxy'''

'''While''' this side up, during your control phase, opponent loses 1 Force. If two assassins (except Galen) are in battle, add one battle destiny. Once per turn, if opponent just lost a character, an assassin there may gain 'reputation;' retrieve any one card (may only be canceled by Aim High) and stack it face down on that assassin. Assassins with 'reputation' may add 1 to Force drains where present. '''Flip''' this card at the end of any turn if opponent's non-droid character at a battleground site (unless [Virtual Block 8] Death Mark is on your side of the table).
|errata_history=This is errata version PC-E1 of [[Contract Killers / Feared Throughout The Galaxy]]; it is the current text. The first image is the Master List slip of the front, which prints it; the second is the release-sheet slip of the unchanged back. The release-sheet slip of the front shows the original text (see [[Contract Killers / Feared Throughout The Galaxy]]).
* '''Original''' ([[Contract Killers / Feared Throughout The Galaxy]]): text as given in the Virtual Block 8.1 release sheet (official text as of 11 May 2012)<ref name="sheet-VirtualBlock8_1">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualBlock8_1.pdf#page=5 Virtual Block 8.1 release sheet] ("Official text as of 11 May 2012"), page 5, slip 24 (position on the sheet; the slip prints no number). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261027095418/https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualBlock8_1.pdf#page=5 Internet Archive]</ref>. Front: “Deploy Coruscant system, Sub City Lair and On The Hunt. For remainder of game, Aurra, Galen, Mara, and your aliens with "plotting to kill Jabba" in lore are assassins. Your cards with ability are deploy +3 except assassins and [Independent] starships. Characters add 1 to their Death Mark total for each weapon or device they carry. Once per turn, may ▼ a Coruscant battleground. Flip this card if assassins control two battlegrounds (unless opponent's non-droid character at a battleground site) or you just drew destiny for [Virtual Block 8] Death Mark.” Back: “While this side up, during your control phase, opponent loses 1 Force. If two assassins (except Galen) are in battle, add one battle destiny. Once per turn, if opponent just lost a character, an assassin there may gain 'reputation;' retrieve any one card (may only be canceled by Aim High) and stack it face down on that assassin. Assassins with 'reputation' may add 1 to Force drains where present. Flip this card at the end of any turn if opponent's non-droid character at a battleground site (unless [Virtual Block 8] Death Mark is on your side of the table).” The release-sheet slips ([[:File:VB8-00-Contract_Killers_Feared_Throughout_The_Galaxy.png]], [[:File:VB8-07-Contract_Killers_Feared_Throughout_The_Galaxy.png]]) print it. The PC website card list (2012–2013) shows no text for this card.
* '''PC-E1''' (this page): the Players Committee Virtual Cards Master List (official text as of 27 April 2013, Dark Side p. 51) changed the front's last words from “or you just drew destiny for [Virtual Block 8] Death Mark.” to “or a [Virtual Block 8] Death Mark attempt is made.”<ref name="ml-ds">[[Media:Virtual_Legacy_Final_Master_DS.pdf|Players Committee Virtual Cards Master List (Dark Side)]], cover "official text as of April 27, 2013" (PDF built February 2014). Original: http://www.starwarsccg.org/Resources/MasterDS.pdf#page=51, page 51. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20170704232650/http://www.starwarsccg.org/Resources/MasterDS.pdf#page=51 Internet Archive]</ref> Front: “Deploy Coruscant system, Sub City Lair and On The Hunt. For remainder of game, Aurra, Galen, Mara, and your aliens with "plotting to kill Jabba" in lore are assassins. Your cards with ability are deploy +3 except assassins and [Independent] starships. Characters add 1 to their Death Mark total for each weapon or device they carry. Once per turn, may ▼ a Coruscant battleground. Flip this card if assassins control two battlegrounds (unless opponent's non-droid character at a battleground site) or a [Virtual Block 8] Death Mark attempt is made.” The back is unchanged. The Master List slip of the front ([[:File:VL-history-1281-24-front-master.png]]) prints it. The Players Committee card images ([[:File:VB8-D-contractkillers-pre.gif]], [[:File:VB8-D-fearedthroughoutthegalaxy-pre.gif]], undated) print a third wording (“Deploy Coruscant, Sub City Lair and On The Hunt.” without “system”, with “attempt is made”, and “of the table.)” on the back); they are not shown here and wait for a ruling.
